name: Nuclear & Radiochemistry
summary: Radioactive decay, nuclear reactions and the chemical handling, detection and uses of radionuclides.

topics.name: Nuclear structure, stability and binding energy
Modes of radioactive decay: alpha, beta, gamma, electron capture and spontaneous fission
Decay kinetics, decay chains and secular equilibrium
Nuclear reactions, cross sections and energetics
Dosimetry, biological effects and radiation protection
Radiation chemistry and hot-atom chemistry (radiolysis of water)
Production of radionuclides: reactors, cyclotrons and generators
